unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 书桌，办公桌；服务台；部门
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There is an English book on the desk.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 书桌 desk，桌上放着笔和本。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What do you do on Sunday mornings?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 助动词与实义动词：Just do it! 去做吧。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little dog is running after a ball.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小狗 dog，人类最忠诚的好朋友。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember to drink enough water every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 喝水 drink water，吃东西 eat food。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Look at that lovely yellow duck in the pond.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小鸭子 duck，水中嘎嘎叫 quack-quack。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Rabbits have two very long ears.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 耳朵 ear，用耳朵听 hear。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Pandas eat green bamboo leaves every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 吃东西 eat，吃肉 meat，喝茶 tea。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I like to have a boiled egg for breakfast.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 鸡蛋 egg，营养健康的早餐。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Can I borrow your eraser to fix this mistake?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: erase(擦除) + er(工具) = 橡皮擦 eraser。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has big bright eyes and a smiling face.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 两个 e 像两只眼睛，中间 y 像鼻子，构成 eye。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wash your face before going to bed.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 笑脸 smiling face，洗脸 wash your face。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I love all members of my family.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 经典巧记：Father And Mother I Love You -> FAMILY。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 父亲，爸爸；创始人，奠基者，先驱
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My father is working in a big hospital.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 父亲 father，家庭的核心顶梁柱。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: There are many golden fish in the river.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小鱼 fish，在盘子 dish 里，或者在水里游。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He walked home on foot yesterday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 脚 foot，复数变元音为 feet；踢足球 football。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little girl is reading a picture book.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 女孩 girl，男孩 boy，校园里快乐奔跑。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Let us go to the library together.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 去、走 go；Ready, set, go!

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 好的；令人愉快的；心地善良的；好心的 `n.` 好处；益处
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She is a very good student in our class.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 好的 good；Good morning! 早上好！

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They said goodbye to each other after school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: good + bye = goodbye，礼貌的再见。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 绿色的；青色的 `n.` 绿色；青色
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The spring leaves turn green and fresh.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 绿色 green，生机勃勃的草地与树木。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 手；(钟表的)指针；帮助 `v.` 交付；递；给
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please wash your hands before dinner.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 手 hand，左手 left hand，右手 right hand。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 快乐的，高兴的；幸福的，使人高兴的；(对某人或某事)满意的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We had a very happy weekend in the park.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 快乐 happy，祝你生日快乐 Happy Birthday!

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have two pencils and an eraser.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拥有 have，吃喝 have lunch / have tea。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is my good friend from Beijing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 他 he，她 she，我 me，你 you。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 头部；才能；头脑；(2) 负责人；领导；校长 `v.` 朝(某方向)行进
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He nodded his head with a broad smile.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 头部 head，从头到脚 head to foot。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Hello! Welcome to our new school.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 最基础问候语：Hello! 你好！

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: This is her new pencil case.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 她/她的 her，形容词性物主代词与宾格同形。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Hey, what are you doing over there?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 口语打招呼或引起注意：Hey!

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Hi, Alice! Nice to meet you here.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 简短亲切的问候语：Hi!

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I asked him for some help with maths.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 他 he 的宾格形式 him。
